{{Quote|A Sith Lord still lives. He killed five Jedi on Tython. He is now on Ambria, under the care of a healer name Caleb. He is badly injured and helpless.|Zannah's message to the Jedi|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] '''strike team''' was formed in response to a message received by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[990 BBY]], informing them of the presence of a grievously injured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].

==History==
Led by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tho'natu]], the strike team of five other Jedi Masters and eight [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] traveled to Ambria aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|Jedi cruiser]] ''[[Light of Truth]]''. There, they found the mutilated corpse of the [[Force healing/Legends|healer]] [[Caleb]], who was mentioned in the message. Outside of Caleb's hut, Tho'natu announced their presence, claiming that they had come to help. However, they were abruptly [[Confrontation on Ambria|attacked]] by the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darovit]]. Tho'natu and the rest of the team quickly overwhelmed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Darovit, who Tho'natu observed fought with recently fallen [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]]'s [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and was also missing a hand. Mistakenly believing Darovit to be the injured [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord that they had been told of, they took Caleb's remains back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a proper funeral, believing the Sith to be exterminated.

Unbeknownst to the strike team, however, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] had sent the message as part of a deal to get Caleb to heal her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], who had been grievously injured during his recent [[Duel on Tython|duel]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. As soon as her Master had been healed, however, Zannah had killed Caleb and [[Summon fear|driven]] Darovit insane, so that he would attack the Jedi when they arrived. Meanwhile, she had [[Force stealth|hidden]] herself and her Master in a trapdoor in Caleb's hut, allowing them to escape from the Jedi and ensuring the survival of the Sith to remain a secret.
